free_text: The conference reached a split between the statistical prior suggesting biopsy and the guideline criterion recommending deferral. The guideline criterion, which matched the reading urologist in 24/24 cases, favored deferral because the mpMRI showed PI-RADS NA, failing the threshold for biopsy. This decision was overturned by the statistical prior, which was driven by the rising PSA trend and csPCa probability.
